days.lo: I’m practicing how to get to the next ten and how to add to numbers like 10, 20, or 30
sc: I can find the sum when adding ones to a multiple of ten.
I can say the number needed to make the next ten.

days.lo: I am learning to add and subtract like units.
sc: I can show how I add like units, tens and ones, to find the sum in an addition expression.
I can show how I subtract like units, tens and ones, to find the difference in a subtraction expression.
I can represent and solve one step word problems by adding and subtracting like units

days.lo: I am learning to make a ten to add within 20.
sc: I can make a ten from one of the two addends in an addition expression to find sums within 20.
I can use a strip diagram and/or drawings to show how to make a ten to add within 20.
I can represent and solve one step word problems by making a ten to add within 20

days.lo: I am learning to make a ten to add within 100.
sc: I can make a ten from one of the two addends in an addition expression to find sums within 100.
I can use a strip diagram and/or drawings to show how I make ten to add within 100.
I can represent and solve one step word problems by making a ten to add within 100

days.lo: I will describe how taking from ten helps me subtract from multiples of ten.
sc: I can create a number bond to subtract a single digit number from multiples of ten.
I can use the “take from ten” strategy when subtracting single digit numbers from multiples of ten.

days.lo: I am learning to take from 10 within 20 when subtracting.
sc: I can draw a 5-group column to subtract a single digit number from a teen number.
I can create a number bond to subtract a single digit number from a teen number.

days.lo: I am learning to take from 10 within 100.
sc: I can draw a pictorial model or strip diagram to subtract a single digit from a double digit number by taking from ten.
I can create a number bond to show the take from ten strategy when subtracting single digit numbers from two digit numbers.

days.lo: I am learning how to use physical manipulatives to measure objects.
sc: I can measure the length of objects using centimeter cubes end to end.
I can compare and describe lengths using addition and subtraction.

days.lo: I am learning how to use one physical unit to measure the length of an object using iteration (repetition).
sc: I can measure the length of an object by placing centimeter cubes end to end.
I can explain how to measure length accurately using centimeter cubes.

days.lo: I am learning to apply concepts to create unit rulers and measure lengths using unit rulers.
sc: I can use centimeter cubes and sentence strip to create a unit ruler.
I can use my created unit ruler to measure length.

days.lo: I am learning to measure various objects using centimeter rulers and meter sticks.
sc: I can determine which measurement tool to use based on the object.
I can measure the length of objects using centimeter rulers and meter sticks.

days.lo: I am learning how to use mental benchmarks when measuring length of objects.
sc: I can explain how to use mental benchmarks when estimating length in centimeters and meters.
I can determine which unit of measurement (cm. or m.) is correct using my knowledge of mental benchmarks.
I can estimate the length of an object using mental benchmarks.

days.lo: I am learning to measure and compare lengths using centimeters and meters.
sc: I can use centimeter rules and meter strips to measure lengths of objects in cm. and m.
I can compare the lengths of objects that I have measured.
I can explain the relationship between centimeters and meters.

days.lo: I am learning how to measure and compare lengths using both standard metric length units and non-standard length units.
sc: I can use physical units to measure the lengths of a line.
I can use a ruler to measure the length of a line.
I can explain the relationship between unit size and measurement.

days.lo: I am learning to measure length of string using measurement tools, and use strip diagrams to represent and compare lengths.
sc: I can estimate and accurately measure the length of string using a meter stick.
I can draw a strip diagram to represent and compare the lengths of objects.

days.lo: I am learning to  apply conceptual understanding of measurement by solving two-step word problems.
sc: I can draw strip diagrams to solve two-step, measurement word problems.
I can explain what strategies I use to solve two-step, measurement word problems.

days.text: Learning Check (2) M2; EOM 2 Assessment, Day 1

days.lo: I am learning how to bundle and count ones, tens, and hundred up to 1,200.
sc: I can represent a number by drawing bundles of ones, tens, and hundreds.
I can determine a number by counting its ones, tens, and hundreds.
I can order place value units from smallest to largest and vice versa.

days.lo: I am learning how to count up and down between 100 and 220 using ones and tens.
sc: I can count up and down from two target numbers between 100 and 220 using ones and tens using words and/or drawings.
I can look  at bundles of hundreds, tens, and ones and determine the value.

days.lo: I am learning how to count up and down between 90 and 1,200 using ones, tens, and hundreds.
sc: I can count up and down from a given number between 90 and 1,200 uses ones, tens, and hundreds using words and/or drawings.
I can look  at bundles of hundreds, tens, and ones and determine the value.

days.lo: I am learning how to write base ten three-digit numbers in unit form and show the value of each digit.
sc: I can write three digit numbers in unit form.
I can use a number bond to show the value of each digit in three-digit numbers.

days.lo: I am learning how to write base ten numbers in expanded form.
sc: I can write base ten numbers in expanded form.
I can look at a number in expanded form (in unit order and out of unit order) and write it in number form.

days.lo: I am learning how to write, read, and relate base ten numbers in all forms.
sc: I can read and write base ten numbers in unit, word, standard, and expanded form.
I can describe the relation between unit, standard, word, and expanded forms.
I can determine the value of each digit in a number.

days.lo: I am learning how to count the total value of $1, $10, and $100 bills up to $1,200.
sc: I can represent a given amount of money using 10 bills: $100, $10, and $1 bills.
I can write the total value of a set of bills as a number bond.
I can write and say each amount of money in instead 9⁹9n expanded form.

days.lo: I am learning how to count from $10 to $1,200 on the place value chart and the empty number line.
sc: I can model counting from $10 to $1,200 using ones, tens, and hundreds on my place value chart.
I can record my count from $10 to $1,200 using ones, tens, and hundreds on an empty number line.

days.lo: I am exploring the value of $1,000 using base-ten and place-value.
sc: I can answer, “How many $10 bills are equal to a $1,000 bill?” using words, pictures, and/or numbers

days.lo: I am learning about place value relationships.
sc: I can correctly model counting on between two numbers by changing 10 ones for 1 ten, 10 tens for 1 hundred, and 10 hundreds for 1 thousand.
I can explain how many ones make a ten, tens make a hundred, and hundreds make a thousand.
I can represent numbers using place value disks.

days.lo: I am learning how to read and write numbers up to 1,200 after modeling with place value disks.
sc: I can draw place value disks to represent numbers up to 1,200.
I can read and write numbers up to 1,200 in unit and word form.
I can draw and label the jumps on an empty number line when counting on between numbers.

days.lo: I am learning how to write numbers in expanded, unit, standard, and word forms.
sc: I can determine the amount of hundreds, tens, and ones in a number.
I can draw place value disks to represent the hundreds, tens, and ones in a number.

days.lo: I am exploring word problem situations with more than 9 groups of ten.
sc: I can solve word problems situations with more than 9 groups of ten using words, pictures, and numbers.
I can explain the strategy I used to solve word problem situations with more than 9 groups of tens.

days.lo: I am learning how to compare numbers to 1,200.
sc: I can use a place value chart to compare numbers to 1,200.
I can use the symbols <, >, and = to compare numbers to 1,200.
I can explain my thinking when comparing numbers to 1,200.

days.lo: I am learning to compare numbers to 1,200 with <, >, and = when there are more than 9 ones, 9 tens, or 9 hundreds.
sc: I can use place value disk to compare numbers using the <, >, = symbols.
I can use a place value chart to compare numbers.
I can compare numbers in standard form.
I can compare numbers in expanded form.
I can compare numbers in unit form.
I can draw pictures to represent its value and compare using the <, >, = symbols.
I can use greater than, less than and equal to in a sentence.

days.lo: I am learning to order numbers in different forms.
sc: I can use place value disk to compare numbers using the <, >, = symbols.
I can use a place value chart to compare numbers.
I can compare numbers in standard form.
I can compare numbers in expanded form.
I can compare numbers in unit form.
I can draw pictures to represent its value and compare using the <, >, = symbols.
I can order three numbers from least to greatest.

weeks.title: Q1:W9 Math IPC Gr2 Eureka Math 26-27

days.lo: I am learning to model 1 more and 1 less, 10 more and 10 less, and 100 more and 100 less when changing the hundreds place.
sc: I can use place value disk to show the value having 10 more and 10 less.
I can use place value disk to show the value having 1 more and 1 less.
I can use place value disk to show the value having 100 more and 100 less.
I can draw pictures to represent a value showing 1 more, 10 more and 100 more.
I can draw pictures to represent a value showing 1 less, 10 less and 100 less.
I can use a word box to make a sentence that describes the value.
I can explain how to compose a new number that shows more or less than the beginning number.

days.lo: I am learning to complete a pattern counting up and down.
sc: I can use place value disk to show the value the value of a number.
I can complete a pattern using place value disk.
I can create a pattern that shows counting by ones, tens, and hundreds.
I can write the numbers in a pattern.
I can complete a pattern using numbers.
